title: Informed Consent
description: The user may not be fully aware of what data is being collected by the wearable device, leading to a lack of informed consent.

title: Data Linkability
description: Sensor telemetry data (e.g., GPS position) can be linked to the user, potentially allowing for tracking and profiling.

title: Data Retention
description: The wearable device may store sensitive data for longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access.

title: Unauthorized Access
description: There is a risk that unauthorized parties could gain access to the data collected by the wearable device.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The wearable device may unintentionally share sensitive data (e.g., GPS traces, exercise sessions) with unauthorized parties during the sync process.

title: Data Interception
description: Data in transit between the wearable device and the companion app could be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to unauthorized access to personal information.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The companion app may store sensitive data insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: User Unawareness of Data Usage
description: Users may not be fully aware of how their data is being used by the companion app, leading to potential misuse of their personal information.

title: Inadequate User Consent
description: The user may not fully understand what data is being collected and how it will be used, leading to a lack of informed consent.

title: Data Leakage
description: The companion app may inadvertently expose user data to unauthorized parties, either through poor security practices or vulnerabilities.

title: Unintended Data Retention
description: The app may retain user data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure in case of a data breach.

title: Metadata Exposure
description: Data in transit may expose metadata that can be used to infer sensitive information about the user, such as their dietary habits or health status.

title: Unauthorized Access to Health Logs
description: The companion mobile app may inadvertently share health logs with unauthorized users due to improper access controls or vulnerabilities in the app.

title: Data Breach of Health Logs
description: The health log store may be susceptible to data breaches, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive health information stored within.

title: Insecure Data Transmission
description: Health logs may be transmitted insecurely, allowing interception by malicious actors during the data flow from the app to the health log store.

title: Unauthorized Access to Location Data
description: The mobile app may inadvertently share GPS location data with unauthorized parties due to insufficient access controls or vulnerabilities in the app.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: GPS location data may be intercepted during transmission to the location history store, leading to potential exposure of sensitive user information.

title: Insecure Storage of Location Data
description: The location history store may not implement adequate security measures, leading to unauthorized access or data breaches of stored location data.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The health log store may inadvertently share sensitive health data with unauthorized parties during the data transfer process.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: Calorie, weight, and exercise logs may be intercepted during transmission, leading to unauthorized access to personal health information.

title: Inadequate Data Protection Measures
description: The health analytics service may not implement sufficient security measures to protect the stored health data, leading to potential breaches.

title: Unintended Secondary Use of Data
description: The analytics service may use the health data for purposes other than originally intended, such as marketing or research, without user consent.

title: Unauthorized Access to Location Data
description: The location history data may be accessed by unauthorized entities during the sharing process, leading to potential misuse of sensitive information.

title: Inaccurate Data Interpretation
description: The analytics service may misinterpret the location data, leading to incorrect conclusions about an individual's daily routine and movement patterns, which could affect personal privacy.

title: Data Retention Risks
description: The health analytics service may retain location data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure or misuse of this sensitive information.

title: Data Aggregation Risks
description: The analytics service may aggregate location data with other datasets, leading to potential identification of individuals and compromising their privacy.

title: Inferred Insights Leakage
description: The health analytics service may inadvertently share sensitive inferred insights about users' health conditions, leading to unauthorized access to personal health information.

title: Data Misuse by App
description: The companion mobile app may misuse the received health insights, either by sharing them with third parties without user consent or by using them for purposes not disclosed to the user.

title: Network Interception
description: Data in transit between the health analytics service and the companion mobile app may be intercepted by unauthorized parties, leading to exposure of sensitive health information.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The app may inadvertently share sensitive health data with unauthorized third parties due to misconfigurations or lack of proper consent mechanisms.

title: Inaccurate Inference of Health Conditions
description: The user may misinterpret the trends and indicators displayed by the app, leading to incorrect self-diagnosis or unnecessary anxiety.

title: Data Retention Risks
description: The app may retain user data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Metadata Leakage
description: During data transmission, metadata about the user's interactions with the app could be intercepted, revealing sensitive information about their health status.

title: User Misunderstanding of Privacy Policies
description: Users may not fully understand the privacy policies associated with the app, leading to unintentional sharing of their health data.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The health analytics service may inadvertently share sensitive health data with the cloud hosting provider without proper consent from the data subjects.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: Analytics data and health datasets may be intercepted during transmission to the cloud hosting provider, leading to unauthorized access.

title: Inadequate Data Protection Measures
description: The cloud hosting provider may not implement sufficient security measures to protect the stored health data, leading to potential breaches.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The cloud hosting provider may retain health data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.
